formal_statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Sym2 (Fin 6))) (B : Fin k → Finset (Finset (Fin 6)))
    (t : Fin k → Fin 6),
    (∀ i, ∀ e ∈ A i, e ∈ (SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun a b : Fin 6 =>
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 2) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 2) ∨
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 4) ∨ (a = 2 ∧ b = 5))).edgeFinset ∧ t i ∈ e) →
    (∀ i, ∀ I ∈ B i, t i ∉ I) →
    (∀ e ∈ (SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun a b : Fin 6 =>
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 2) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 2) ∨
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 4) ∨ (a = 2 ∧ b = 5))).edgeFinset,
      ∀ I : Finset (Fin 6), (∀ u ∈ I, ∀ w ∈ I, ¬ (SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun a b : Fin 6 =>
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 2) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 2) ∨
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 4) ∨ (a = 2 ∧ b = 5))).Adj u w) →
        ∃! i : Fin k, e ∈ A i ∧ I ∈ B i) →
    9 ≤ k
plain_statement: For the net graph on 6 vertices (a triangle 0,1,2 with one pendant vertex at each corner), suppose all pairs (edge, independent set) are split into k rectangles, each a set of edges times a set of vertex sets with a label vertex lying in all its edges and in none of its sets, every pair in exactly one rectangle. Then k is at least 9, which is the number of edges plus the least size of a vertex cover (6 plus 3).
title: The net needs at least 9 rectangles: edges plus cover number on a triangle with three pendant edges (standalone text)
